subject: chemistry
question_text: Classify the oxide B₂O₃ as neutral, acidic, basic or amphoteric.

mark_split.label: The classification and the water reaction

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: The classification and the water reaction
lines: Boron trioxide B₂O₃ is an acidic oxide.
With water it gives orthoboric acid, so
it is the anhydride of that acid:
Atoms: 2 B, 6 H and 6 O on each side.
steps.why: An oxide that gives an acid with water is called an acid anhydride, and that is the plainest evidence that the oxide is acidic. Boron is the smallest and least metallic member of group 13, so its oxide is the acidic one.
common_mistakes: Calling B₂O₃ amphoteric. It reacts with a base but not with an acid, so it is acidic.
Writing HBO₂ as the product with water. Water gives orthoboric acid H₃BO₃; metaboric acid HBO₂ is formed when H₃BO₃ is heated.
steps.memory_tip: B₂O₃ plus water gives boric acid, so B₂O₃ is the anhydride of boric acid.
steps.margin_note: The word anhydride with the water equation states the acidic character.

steps.label: The reaction with an alkali
lines: With a strong alkali it gives a salt and
water, which is the test of an acidic
The salt is sodium metaborate NaBO₂.
steps.why: Reacting with a base to give a salt and water is the definition of an acidic oxide, so this equation answers the question directly. The oxides of group 13 change class down the group: B₂O₃ acidic, Al₂O₃ amphoteric, Tl₂O₃ basic.
common_mistakes: Writing B₂O₃ + NaOH → NaBO₂ + H₂O. Two molecules of NaOH are needed for the equation to balance.
Giving Na₃BO₃ as the salt here. The orthoborate needs six molecules of alkali; with 2NaOH the product is the metaborate NaBO₂.
steps.memory_tip: An acidic oxide plus an alkali gives a salt and water: B₂O₃ gives the metaborate.
steps.margin_note: One balanced equation with an alkali completes the answer.

insider_note: Boron is the one member of group 13 whose oxide is purely acidic, and the water equation is the quickest way to show it: an oxide that gives an acid with water is an acid anhydride.
